title: Department library with HOD moderation
description: A school-level worksheet library separate from a teacher's personal templates. HODs curate which worksheets become 'department-approved'; teachers see them under a 'Department library' tab. Drives MAT/site licences because it's the artefact a HOD owns.
rationale: User's improvement #18. Department-level governance is the gap between 'enthusiastic teacher uses it' and 'whole school uses it'. A two-tier library (personal + department) with a moderation queue is the smallest amount of governance that earns site licence sign-off.
steps: Schema: add `department_library` table (id, schoolId, departmentName, worksheetSnapshotId, status: 'draft'|'in-review'|'approved'|'rejected', curatedBy, approvedBy, notes). Drizzle migration.
Roles: extend the user role enum to include `HOD` (Head of Department). HOD-of-X manages the X department's library.
- POST /api/dept-library — submit a worksheet (snapshot the current version into the library, status: 'in-review' if submitter is teacher, 'approved' if HOD).
- GET  /api/dept-library?dept=… — list approved + (if HOD) in-review entries.
- POST /api/dept-library/:id/decision — HOD approves / rejects with notes.
- On Worksheets toolbar: 'Submit to department' button.
- On History rows: 'In department library' badge if part of dept library.
Notifications: in-app + transactional email when a submission is decided on (reuse PD4/PD5 email infra).
files_to_touch: client/src/pages/Worksheets.tsx (Submit to department button — ≤ 30 LOC delta)
acceptance_criteria: A teacher submits a worksheet → it appears in the HOD's 'In review' tab.
HOD approves → it appears in everyone's 'Approved' list and the submitter receives notification.
Non-HOD users cannot see the decision tab.
verification: Manual: as a teacher submit a sheet; as the HOD approve; confirm visibility.
